title: Sample and battle the four rows and post the results table
headline: A row beats the control when its curve sits lower and further right
setup: Each row is a way to train and sample the model. Its teams are battled at guidance 2, 4 and 8, so a row becomes a curve of three points. This ticket runs those battles and judges each row against the control, Per-field, uncorrected t.
alt: Nothing has run yet. Each battled row becomes a curve of three points, one for each guidance value. A row wins when its ask-versus-got error is at least 0.001 lower than the control's at two or more guidance values, and it loses at none.
terms: One way to train and sample the model. Four are compared. The control is Per-field, uncorrected t: our own settings
The order fields are filled in: all six species first, or any order
The ask is the win rate the model is told to aim for. Got is the win rate its teams then score
A team's six species. More distinct line-ups means more variety
How hard the sampler pushes toward the win rate asked for. 1 is no push, and higher pushes harder
How far the win rate the teams get is from the win rate asked for. Lower is better. A row must be 0.001 lower to count

frames.title: 1. Error against line-ups, one curve for each row
frames.takes: Each row is a three-point curve; the control's curve is the line to beat.
frames.expected: Linear, species-first sits on the control's curve. Linear, random order sits further right but higher.
frames.surprise: A linear curve lies wholly below the control's.

frames.title: 2. Got against ask for the control and Linear, species-first
frames.takes: Got should follow ask; a line short of the dashed diagonal misses it.
frames.expected: Both lines overlap and stop rising at the same got.
frames.surprise: The linear line keeps rising after the control line stops.

frames.title: 3. Random order's error as a multiple of species-first's
frames.takes: On a per-field model, random order's error was 2.8 times species-first's. On the linear model it is unknown.
frames.expected: On the linear model the multiple falls below 2.8 but stays above 1.
frames.surprise: It stays near 2.8, or falls below 1.

frames.title: 4. When a row counts as winning

items.text: Win at one guidance value: error at least 0.001 lower, interval below zero
Loss at one value: interval above zero
The row wins: a win at two or more values and a loss at none
One win in three: reported as weak

frames.takes: A row wins when it wins at two or more guidance values and loses at none. A win needs an error at least 0.001 lower.
frames.expected: A row that wins twice and matches once still counts as winning.
frames.surprise: A row that wins twice and loses once does not count as winning.
